BiblicalUsage: Shelomi is named once, as the father of Ahihud, prince of the tribe of Asher, who helped divide the land. The father is named so the son's authority can be traced.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the division of the land was a holy business, and the men who did it are named. Shelomi's son Ahihud stood for Asher, and I hold that God assigns His people their portion.
